name: Teia Moderator Contract
description: This contract manages a set of moderator addresses for the Teia platform. Multisig wallet users can propose to add or remove moderators, update the linked multisig address or update contract metadata. Proposals require a minimum number of votes and expire after a configurable time, both fetched from the linked multisig contract.
